touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Llanfihangel-y-Pennant qualifies as a local detour through Castell y Bere and Church of St Michael. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Llanfihangel-y-Pennant: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Llanfihangel-y-Pennant offers Castell y Bere, Church of St Michael, Graveyard monument at the Church of St Michael within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Castell y Bere
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Castell y Bere and Church of St Michael, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
